label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: Whatever causes the necessity of a NECESSARY_1 being…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., tertia via: procedatur in infinitum in necessariis quae habent causam suae necessitatis
interpretation: The regress Aquinas excludes runs 'in necessariis': a series whose members are necessary beings. Read as presupposing that whatever causes a necessary being's necessity is itself necessary. The text does not argue this; withoutNecessaryCauseNoPerSe shows the conclusion needs it.
